lucide-clipboard-copy size-4" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="8" height="4" x="8" y="2" rx="1" ry="1"></rect><path d="M8 4H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="ADE-tools">智能体开发环境工具<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 不只是一个 Agent 输入框，也是一套面向真实开发任务的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Agent Development Environment</strong>。你可以在一个窗口里管理任务、按工作区组织对话、进入远程开发环境、预览网页、点选页面元素作为上下文，并在 Review 面板里确认 Agent 生成的改动。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="workspace-file-tree">工作区与任务列表<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">左侧边栏会跟随当前工作区展示任务列表。顶部是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建任务</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">搜索</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">技能</strong> 三个入口，下面按工作区（如 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">ZCodeProject</code>）归类列出每个对话任务。每一行会显示任务标题、相对时间（如「1 天」），以及运行中、未读、失败等状态点；任务产生改动后还会显示该任务的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">+/-</code> 变更行数，方便快速判断 Agent 在哪些任务里改了多少内容。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-workspace-task-list.webp" alt="工作区任务列表" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击列表上方的视图按钮可以切换任务的组织方式：<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">分组</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作区</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">时间线</strong>。在非分组视图下还能选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">排序方式</strong>，按 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">创建时间</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">更新时间</strong> 排列任务。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-task-view-sort.webp" alt="任务视图与排序方式" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">切换到 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">分组</strong> 视图后，可以新建分组，把相关任务整理到自定义分组里，适合按项目、需求或主题把长期任务归拢在一起。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-task-groups.webp" alt="任务分组" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="archived-tasks">归档任务<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不再活跃的任务可以归档，从主列表里收起来。打开归档视图后会看到所有已归档任务的扁平列表，每一行同样显示标题、相对时间、变更统计和所属工作区，并提供 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">恢复</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">删除</strong> 操作。需要回顾旧任务时可以随时恢复，确认无用后再永久删除。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-archived-tasks.webp" alt="归档任务" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="command-center">命令中心<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">按 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Command + K</code>（或点击顶部的搜索入口）可以打开命令中心，在一个面板里快速触达常用操作和导航。它同时覆盖命令、对话和文件三类搜索：新建对话、打开文件夹、搜索文件、设置、上一个 / 下一个对话、查找、返回 / 前进、切换主题、MCP 服务器、个性化、切换终端等都能直接执行，不必到处找菜单。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-command-center.webp" alt="命令中心快捷入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="remote-development">远程开发（SSH / Docker）<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在「打开工作区」页面可以选择本地文件夹，也可以进入「远程连接」。远程开发适合把 ZCode Agent 接到服务器、开发机或容器环境里工作，让 Agent 在真实运行环境中读取文件、执行命令和推进任务。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">远程开发会先选择连接方式，目前包含 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">SSH 远程主机</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Docker 本地容器</strong>。SSH 适合连接远端服务器或开发机，Docker 适合进入本机已有的容器环境。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-ssh-connection-method.webp" alt="选择远程连接方式" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<div data-docs-nav-cards="true" class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 my-8"><a class="group relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-neutral-900/50 p-4 transition-all hover:bg-neutral-800/50 hover:border-white/20" href="/cn/docs/remote-development"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-sky-400 transition-colors">远程开发</h4></div><p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">查看 SSH 远程主机、Docker 本地容器、连接日志和常见问题。</p></a></div>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="browser">内置浏览器<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 内置了一个浏览器面板，可以在应用里直接打开本地开发地址或线上页面。它带地址栏和前进、后退、刷新、开发者工具按钮，支持 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">http</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">https</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">file</code> 等协议。除了你自己浏览，Agent 也可以驱动它去访问和操作网页。浏览器面板 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅桌面端可用</strong>。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="browser-element-context">把页面元素选成上下文<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">打开浏览器标签、输入页面地址后，点击工具栏里的元素选择按钮进入点选模式。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/zcode-docs-20260613-ade-browser-element-picker.webp" alt="浏览器元素选择" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击页面里的按钮、卡片、标题或其他元素，ZCode 会采集页面标题、URL、元素文本、选择器、位置和安全的 HTML 摘要，并把它加入当前聊天。这样你可以直接对 Agent 说「修改刚才选中的卡片」或「优化这个按钮文案」，不用描述它在页面的哪个位置。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="browser-use">让 Agent 操作网页<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">开启内置浏览器控制后，Agent 可以自己打开网址、点击、填表并验证结果，过程在面板里实时可见。开关、登录态导入和数据清理都在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 浏览器</strong>，完整说明见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/browser-use">浏览器自动化</a>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="preview">文件与内容预览<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点击文件树里的文件会在右侧预览面板打开，除了代码，几类常见格式也能直接看。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260730-core-features/file-preview/markdown-release-report.webp" alt="左侧文件树带 Git 状态标识，右侧预览面板打开 Agent 生成的 Markdown 发布报告：执行摘要、风险分级表格与发布门禁清单都渲染完整" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">PDF</strong> 支持翻页、跳页和缩放（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Command</code> / <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Ctrl</code> + 滚轮可以按指针位置连续缩放），文字能选中复制。它是只读的，不提供编辑和批注。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">HTML 文件</strong> 在文件树里右键选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用内置浏览器打开</strong>，会在浏览器面板里新开一个标签渲染它。这个菜单项只在本地工作区出现，远程工作区不提供。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">对话里的内容也有对应的查看方式：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Mermaid 图表</strong>：回复里的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">mermaid</code> 代码块会直接渲染成图，点右上角的放大按钮或双击图表可以打开大图，支持缩放、拖拽平移，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Esc</code> 关闭。消息还在输出时会先显示源码，写完才切换成图。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">图片</strong>：Markdown 图片可以点开预览，连续多张会自动排成图集，用左右箭头或方向键翻看，支持缩放、拖拽和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">下载</strong>当前这张。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">表格</strong>：Markdown 表格自带工具栏，可以 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">复制</strong>成 Markdown、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">下载</strong>成 CSV，或者打开一个更大的预览窗口（滚动时表头吸顶）。很宽的表格还能展开滚动区域，让它横向占用更多空间，再点一次收回。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="terminal-debug">命令行与调试<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">右上角的终端按钮或 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">Command + J</code> 可以打开命令行面板。你可以在同一个工作区里运行构建、测试、启动服务、查看日志，再把结果继续交给 Agent 分析。命令行面板也集成在预览面板中，可以边看预览边执行命令。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">内置浏览器也提供调试工具入口，适合前端项目在预览页面的同时检查 DOM、控制台输出和样式问题。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="background-commands">后台执行长命令<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">启动开发服务器、跑一整套测试这类耗时命令，Agent 可以放到后台执行：命令继续跑，当前回合不必等它结束，你可以接着提问或让 Agent 做别的事，需要时再回来查看输出。<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/subagents#background">子智能体</a> 同样支持后台执行。</p>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="native-search">增强的 Find 和 Grep<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在大仓库里搜东西容易慢，而且结果还取决于你机器上装的是哪个版本的 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">find</code> 和 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">grep</code>。ZCode 自带了更快的替代品，Agent 默认就用它们，搜得更快，各台机器上的表现也一致。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这项设置在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 常规 → 增强 Find 和 Grep</strong>，默认开启。改完要 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">新建会话才生效</strong>，正在进行的会话保持原样；Windows 上只替换 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">grep</code>，<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">find</code> 保持系统原样。远程工作区（WSL / SSH / Docker）暂不适用。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="remote-access">远程接入<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 的远程接入分两类。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">远程开发</strong> 决定代码和命令在哪台机器上跑；<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Remote Control</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Bot Channel</strong> 则是你人不在电脑前时的操作入口，控制的都是桌面端已有的会话。</p>
<div data-docs-nav-cards="true" class="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 my-8"><a class="group relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-neutral-900/50 p-4 transition-all hover:bg-neutral-800/50 hover:border-white/20" href="/cn/docs/remote-development"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-sky-400 transition-colors">远程开发</h4></div><p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">通过 SSH 主机或 Docker 容器打开工作区，让 Agent 在目标环境里执行。</p></a><a class="group relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-neutral-900/50 p-4 transition-all hover:bg-neutral-800/50 hover:border-white/20" href="/cn/docs/remote-control"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-sky-400 transition-colors">Remote Control</h4></div><p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">通过手机扫码接入当前 ZCode 工作区。</p></a><a class="group relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-neutral-900/50 p-4 transition-all hover:bg-neutral-800/50 hover:border-white/20" href="/cn/docs/bot-channel"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-sky-400 transition-colors">Bot Channel</h4></div><p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">通过 Bot Channel 从聊天工具打开工作区。</p></a></div>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
